cabinCategories.description: Comfortable Freestyle interior stateroom with flexible dining and NCL's signature amenities. Two lower beds convertible to queen.
Ocean view stateroom with large picture window to enjoy the stunning Alaskan coastline. Freestyle dining included.
Private balcony stateroom — perfect for watching Alaska's incredible scenery and wildlife from your own outdoor space.
The Haven Suite — NCL's ship-within-a-ship experience with private pool, dedicated restaurant, and 24-hour butler service.

entertainmentOptions: Howl at the Moon dueling pianos
inclusions: All meals in main dining and Garden Café buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Norwegian Joy sets sail on a 9-night Alaskan adventure.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A beautiful scenic sea day cruising the Inside Passage. Enjoy Norwegian Joy's full lineup of activities while Alaska's wilderness rolls past outside.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital city nestled between mountains and the Gastineau Channel. Visit Mendenhall Glacier, go whale watching in Auke Bay, or explore the vibrant downtown waterfront.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A living museum of the Klondike Gold Rush era. Ride the historic White Pass & Yukon Route Railway through dramatic mountain scenery.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of scenic cruising through one of the world's most spectacular wilderness areas. A National Park Ranger boards to narrate as you glide past towering glaciers.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: A gem of Southeast Alaska blending Russian heritage and Tlingit culture. Visit St. Michael's Cathedral, the Sitka National Historical Park, and watch sea otters in the harbor.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: The 'Salmon Capital of the World.' Explore Creek Street's colorful waterfront history and view the world's largest collection of totem poles at Totem Bight State Park.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An elegant evening arrival in British Columbia's charming capital. Visit the Inner Harbour or stroll through Government Street's boutiques and cafés.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: Longer 9-night itineraries leave room for Sitka and Glacier Bay as well as the usual ports, with a go-kart track and water slides for sea days — good for travelers who want more time in Alaska.

overrides.note: Summer 2027: 7-night round-trips (weekly check mismatch, confirmed via cruisesheet / alaskacruises.com). Aug 13 added: 7-day gap to next departure.
